scope: Repair re-review regression observed after R1/R2 repair; preserves original findings separately.
checked_surfaces: Whole repaired pre-commit and dispatcher; whole expanded test_data_hygiene module.
Invented safe staged blob paired with cat-file blob failure shim; complete command output read.

gates.name: Neutral diagnostics after scan-stage failure
gates.reason: Safe control exited 0; Git shim cat-file blob failure produced hook exit 2 and empty stderr.

findings.evidence: The scan loop compound redirection done 2>/dev/null suppresses stderr throughout its body, including fail() diagnostics on type/blob/matcher/redaction faults. Independent invented-data counterexample: git shim refusing cat-file blob with status23 yields hook status2 and no diagnostic. Neutral D4 operational diagnostic is lost. Narrow suppression to the open operation or keep a separate diagnostic descriptor, and assert diagnostic content for fault cases.
